SonicSunset resource map
=========================
Generated 2026-10-02 from the two GameCube disc images in the project root:
  Sonic Adventure DX.iso   (GXSE8P, Sonic Adventure DX: Director's Cut, GameCube)
  Shadow The Hedgehog.iso  (GUPE8P, Shadow the Hedgehog, GameCube)

What this file is: a lookup table of the game assets on those discs - models, textures, audio,
animations and collision - with a short note on what each one is and where to read it from.
Everything else (object layouts, cameras, paths, scripts, fonts, UI layouts, videos, text, save data,
code-only modules) is left out on purpose.

Line format:   name | what it is [label] | path
Path format:   <file on disc>                  a file at that path on the disc
               <file on disc> > <entry>        an entry inside a Shadow .ONE archive (PRS-compressed)
               <file on disc> @ 0xOFFSET       data at that file offset inside a SADX .rel module
                                               (pointers inside need relocateRel first)

Labels (how sure the 'what it is' is):
  [obs]  observed in these files (parsed or decoded in this project)
  [ext]  external source: SA Tools GameConfig, HeroesONE-Reloaded, format docs. Can be wrong.
  [hyp]  hypothesis (from names, magic bytes or context)
  [?]    unknown


####################################################################################################
# Sonic Adventure DX (GameCube) - Sonic Adventure DX.iso
####################################################################################################

== Models, animations and land tables inside .rel modules ==
Names, types and offsets: SA Tools GameConfig/GC_SADX/*.ini [ext] (key=C900000, big-endian).
Texture names refer to texture archives; '-> file' means a .gvm with that name exists on the disc [hyp].
Model = Ninja basic model (NJS_OBJECT tree, non-DX struct sizes), readable by importSAModel [obs for Sonic: walked in a script, not yet run in the engine].
Land table = stage geometry + collision flags per piece [ext].

####################################################################################################
# Shadow the Hedgehog (GameCube) - Shadow The Hedgehog.iso
####################################################################################################

== Entry types inside .ONE archives ==
  .DFF  RenderWare clump: model [ext; parsed only in character/shadow.one]
  .BSP  RenderWare world: level geometry [ext]
  .TXD  RenderWare texture dictionary [ext]
  .BON  named bone hierarchy for the .DFF it belongs to [obs in character/shadow.one, hyp elsewhere]
  .MTP  motion package, probably animations [hyp]
  .MTN  motion, probably animation [hyp]
  .CCL  probably collision [hyp]
  .UVA  RenderWare UV animation [ext]
  .DMA  probably RenderWare delta morph animation [hyp]
  .SNB  probably camera animation (names like CAM_*) [hyp]
  .EFD  probably effect data [hyp]
